title: Three Discs with Heart
description: Three iridescent compact discs are scattered across a pale, ink-washed ground of gestural grey marks, drips, and curving lines. Below the lowest disc sits a bold outlined heart rendered in black ink, anchoring the composition at bottom center.
composition: three discs scattered above central heart
keywords: iridescent CD on ink wash ground
dimensions_source: cd-reference: 3 CDs measured (1.3% spread), mean 438.6px dia = 92.92px/in, applied to 1728x2800 native. Circle fit confirmed against disc edge at high zoom. Verified 2026-08-04.
